song: 35 - GRUPO EXTRA -   LA MITAD - VERSION BACHATA - VIDEO OFICIAL
title: lavender liquid breathing the bachata stroke
story: Grupo Extra's bachata opens on a steady eighth-note groove under a sung line, so the liquid stays crisp and thin and each guitar-and-bongo stroke lifts the agitation a little. The open tone on beat 4 pushes the agitation, the brightness and a shake together. At bar 36 (2609) the harmony changes: the liquid crossfades into its second colour over two bars and the hue and contrast open at the 2758 boundary. Afterwards the liquid settles into its half-bar swing, centre left and right, with the same stroke pulses.
